issues.on_page: Local Fees, Licenses, Commissions, and Miscellaneous 2,259,478
issues.issue: This is a broad group. 1,144,941 (51%) is Health Insurance Claims Fund receipts (likely premium contributions, not licenses) and 331,275 is Inheritance Tax Fund receipts (likely inheritance tax), p5. Licenses and permits comes from the user's category decision but doesn't describe most of the money.

issues.on_page: Inheritance Tax Fund: Local Fees, Licenses, Commissions, and Miscellaneous 331,275
issues.issue: An inheritance tax fund's only non-interest receipt is probably inheritance tax, but it's printed as local fees, not as taxes, so the fund-name rule doesn't apply. Kept as printed. A person should decide.

issues.on_page: Health Insurance Claims Fund: Local Fees, Licenses, Commissions, and Miscellaneous 1,144,941
issues.issue: Health insurance claims fund receipts are probably employee/employer premium contributions or reimbursements, not licenses and permits.
The schedule doesn't break this down. Highway allocation is an assumption.

The schedules don't say what the capital outlay bought. Equipment purchases (and land and buildings for Buildings and Grounds, construction/infrastructure for Road Bridge Buyback) are the extractor's assumptions. This applies to every Capital Outlay detail line.
